key_insight: BAQ-TD preserves the near-optimal unquantized TD error rate of Õ(1/T) using only O(d log T) total transmitted bits.
engineering_relevance: Communication-constrained reinforcement learning systems can evaluate policies with linear value approximations while sharply reducing agent-to-server traffic.
method: Batch TD update estimates to reduce variance.
Adaptively quantize innovations sent over a finite-capacity channel.
Use the quantized updates for server-side policy evaluation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a high-probability finite-time error bound and an exponential communication-complexity improvement over prior work, but no empirical evaluation.
watch_item: The guarantee requires channel capacity above a finite threshold and applies to policy evaluation with linear function approximation.
paper_title: Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels
